## What changed

Explain the user-visible or developer-visible outcome.

## Validation

- [ ] `bun run check`
- [ ] Relevant integration or browser flows
- [ ] Fresh-template, production, or distribution smoke when affected

## Review notes

- [ ] Public HTTP changes update TypeSpec and generated artifacts.
- [ ] Migrations and rollback impact are documented.
- [ ] Architecture changes update the relevant ADR.
- [ ] No credentials, local environment files, or generated runtime artifacts are included.
- [ ] Breaking changes are explicit.
